title: Section 2(10) - Definition of Defect
text: Defect means any fault, imperfection or shortcoming in the quality, quantity, potency, purity or standard which is required to be maintained by or under any law for the time being in force or under any contract, express or implied or as is claimed by the trader in any manner whatsoever in relation to any goods or product.
tags: Defines actionable faults in physical goods and products.

metadata.legal_purpose: Defines actionable faults in physical goods and products.

title: Section 2(11) - Definition of Deficiency
text: Deficiency means any fault, imperfection, shortcoming or inadequacy in the quality, nature and manner of performance which is required to be maintained by or under any law for the time being in force or has been undertaken to be performed by a person in pursuance of a contract or otherwise in relation to any service.
tags: Defines actionable shortcomings in professional, commercial, or public services.

metadata.legal_purpose: Defines actionable shortcomings in professional, commercial, or public services.

title: Section 2(28) - Definition of Misleading Advertisement
text: Misleading advertisement in relation to any product or service means an advertisement, which falsely describes such product or service, or gives a false guarantee to, or is likely to mislead the consumers as to the nature, substance, quantity or quality of such product or service.
tags: Prohibits deceptive sales marketing, false guarantees, or scientific misrepresentations.

metadata.legal_purpose: Prohibits deceptive sales marketing, false guarantees, or scientific misrepresentations.

title: Section 2(47) - Definition of Unfair Trade Practice
text: Unfair trade practice means a trade practice which, for the purpose of promoting the sale, use or supply of any goods or for the provision of any service, adopts any unfair method or unfair or deceptive practice including making false or misleading representation, refusal to refund paid consideration within 30 days, or disclosing confidential personal information.
tags: Establishes comprehensive prohibition against deceptive commercial conduct and mandatory 30-day refund rules.

metadata.legal_purpose: Establishes comprehensive prohibition against deceptive commercial conduct and mandatory 30-day refund rules.

title: Section 39 - Findings of District Commission and Statutory Orders
text: Where the District Commission is satisfied that the goods complained against suffer from any of the defects specified in the complaint or that any of the allegations contained in the complaint about services or unfair trade practices are proved, it shall issue an order directing the opposite party to remove defects, replace goods with defect-free items, return the price paid along with interest, or pay compensation.
tags: Findings of District Commission and Statutory Orders
Empowers District Consumer Commissions to issue binding statutory orders for refund, replacement, or damages.

metadata.legal_purpose: Empowers District Consumer Commissions to issue binding statutory orders for refund, replacement, or damages.

title: Section 83 & 84 - Product Liability Action and Manufacturer Liability
text: A product liability action may be brought by a complainant against a product manufacturer, product service provider, or product seller for any harm caused on account of a defective product. A product manufacturer shall be liable if the product contains a manufacturing defect, design defect, or non-conformance with express warranty.
tags: Product Liability Action and Manufacturer Liability
Establishes strict product liability claims against manufacturers and distributors for physical or property harm.

metadata.legal_purpose: Establishes strict product liability claims against manufacturers and distributors for physical or property harm.

title: Section 87 - Exceptions to Product Liability Action
text: A product liability action cannot be brought against the product seller or manufacturer if at the time of harm the product was misused, altered, or modified by the consumer, or if the danger was obvious or commonly known.
tags: Provides statutory defenses for manufacturers and sellers where consumer misuse or obvious danger occurred.

metadata.legal_purpose: Provides statutory defenses for manufacturers and sellers where consumer misuse or obvious danger occurred.
